text:
Maya: Midnight alert from nightly perf dash: p50 +18ms, p95 +120ms on model x-large. kernel-selector entropy up, kv hit rate down ~7%. Putting triage here. https://dash.internal/redwood/nightly/12345 :eyes:
Priya: seeing the same in canary. spike starts right after merge 78f9a2. also more small batches in the logs.
Carlos: starting bisect across 78f9a2..HEAD. kicking off perf-bisect job now. will post results.
infra-bot: perf-bisect started (job perf-20260301-42) :robot_face:
Ben: pushed revert of the kernel-priority tweak to canary (revert PR #412). monitoring.
Maya: thanks — can you post the revert sha when you have it?
Ben: revert sha: a1b2c3d
Priya: did a quick profile on affected traces — kernel switch count increased ~3x, kv cache eviction rate spiked. snippet: ```profile summary
kernel_switches: 12 -> 36
kv_evictions_per_sec: 4.2 -> 14.9
hotpath: selector::choose_kernel -> prefetch::evict_when_busy```
Tiffany: note that batching heuristics change in PR 409 bumped the low-qps batch window 8ms -> 20ms. that can increase async handoffs and produce more smaller batches; could interact poorly with selector.
Carlos: bisect done: culprit commit = 78f9a2 (merge "adaptive-kernel-thresholds"). reproducer: run nightly with `--simulated-load 300rps` and watch selector oscillation.
Maya: OK. does the revert bring perf back to baseline?
Ben: canary with revert shows p95 back to baseline within ~5m. rolling back main now.
Priya: CI night job also failed earlier: `ci-nightly-latency` shows ~14% regression in our regression suite. https://ci.internal/jobs/987
ci-bot: ci-nightly-latency failed on test `kernel_selector_perf` — flakiness / noise observed.
Tiffany: i'll open a small patch to add hysteresis to the selector to avoid rapid flips and include unit + perf tests.
Maya: good. for postmortem we should capture the interaction between selector epsilon, batching window, and KV prefetch timing. assign owners?
Carlos: i'll own the bisect writeup + metric diffs.
Priya: i'll own profiling artifacts + flamegraphs.
Ben: i'll track the revert rollout and coordinate canary -> main rollback with infra.
Maya: thanks team :thumbsup: closing when deploy stabilizes.
